name: Geor
description: A Havengul fisher who fishes for something big and warns about gryffs.

description_citations.work: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt: card flavor text (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geor is determined to stay out fishing until something big bites.
timeline.quote: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

citation.text: Baithook Angler (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geor advises following a gryff when lost in a storm.
timeline.quote: If you're lost in a storm, follow a gryff. They always know which way calmer waters lie.

citation.text: Galedrifter (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geor sees a gryff that is no longer a gryff.
timeline.quote: Wait! That's no gryff—at least not anymore.

citation.text: Waildrifter (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
